rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FULL INSURANCE COVERAGE TO ALL QUALIFIED AGRARIAN REFORM BENEFICIARIES OF THE COMPREHENSIVE AGRARIAN REFORM PROGRAM, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 14 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9700, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"COMPREHENSIVE AGRARIAN REFORM PROGRAM EXTENSION WITH REFORMS\"
rows.title_short: Granting Full Insurance Coverage To All Qualified Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries Of The Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Program
rows.abstract:
Provides for additional form of support service to qualified beneficiaries of the CARP by including to compensable losses those resulting from natural calamities such as typhoon, flood, drought, earthquake, volcanic eruption, frost, and other destructive natural phenomena such as heat and hot wind; plant diseases caused by pathogens, bacteria, fungi, viruses, virus-like pathogens, and other similar foreign bodies; pest infestations caused by nematodes, insects, mites and spiders, millipedes and centipedes, symphylans, slugs and snails, sow bugs and pillbugs, parasistic higher plants, and other parasites, and loss of life and/or injury to the qualified agrarian reform beneficiary due to accident or any of the aforementioned causes.

Covers the following crops: palay, corn, sugarcane, high-value crops as defined in Section 4(b) of RA 7900, otherwise known as the “High-Value Crops Development Act of 1995\", coconut, and tobacco; aquaculture;livestock; and non-crop agricultural assets.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-06-01, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-06-03 and received by the Senate on 2020-06-03

rows.author: H017
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A COMPREHENSIVE SYSTEM FOR THE REGISTRATION AND LICENSING OF SOCIAL WELFARE AND DEVELOPMENT AGENCIES AND ACCREDITATION OF SOCIAL WELFARE AND DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS AND SERVICES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Establishing A Comprehensive System For The Registration And Licensing Of Social Welfare And Development Agencies And Accreditation Of Social Welfare And Development Programs And Services
rows.abstract: Aims to ensure that social welfare and development programs and services in the public and private sectors comply with the national standards and adhere to the principle of human rights. It shall register, license, accredit, and monitor social welfare and development agencies, service providers, groups or organizations engaged in social welfare and development activities, provide appropriate consultative mechanisms to enable mutual beneficial engagements of the private sector  and its government counterparts, and develop standards to meet the challenges and demands of the services provided to the poor, the vulnerable, the marginalized, the disadvantages, and the underprivileged sectors of Philippine society.
rows.status: Business for the day on 2020-03-10

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 129, 164 AND 225 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8424, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to address the proliferation of illicit trade on tobacco products which was alleged to be brought about by several increases in excise tax.

Tasks the B I R to exercise regulatory authority over all articles subject to excise tax such as those produced or kept in areas such as but not limited to Special Economic Zones, Economic Zones, and freeports pending investigation of violations of the provisions of Art.129 of NIRC Code of 1997.

Describes several instances when an act is considered an offense of engaging in the illicit trade of cigarettes/tobacco products; specifies persons or parties who shall be held accountable for the commission of an offense; and provides for corresponding fines and/or penalties for violation of this Act.

rows.author: H005
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING VOLUNTEERISM AS A STRATEGY FOR NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT AND DECLARING DECEMBER AS NATIONAL VOLUNTEER MONTH, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 12 AND 13 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9418, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"VOLUNTEER ACT OF 2007\"
rows.title_short: Institutionalizing Volunteerism As A Strategy For National Development And Declaring December As National Volunteer Month
rows.abstract:
Institutionalizes the Philippine Volunteer Awards Program (PNVAP) comprising of a National Outstanding Volunteer award (NOVA) which shall be conferred by the President of the Philippines to recognize the exemplary contributions, dedication to service and achievements of individuals and organization in uplifting the lives of people and communities through volunteerism; and a Local Outstanding Volunteer Award (LOVA) which recognizes the significant contributions of volunteer individuals and groups in the development of their respective communities and shall be implemented by the Local Government Unit and conferred by the respective Local Chief Executive.

Declares the month of December of every year as National Volunteer Month which celebration shall be spearheaded by the PNVSCA for coordination purposes.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-08-24, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-09-01 and received by the Senate on 2020-09-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING POOR JOB APPLICANTS A 20% DISCOUNT IN THE PAYMENT OF FEES AND CHARGES FOR CERTAIN CERTIFICATES AND CLEARANCES ISSUED BY GOVERNMENT AGENCIES
rows.title_short: Poor Job Applicants Discount Act
rows.abstract:
Refers poor job applicant to a person who is seeking gainful employment and has no visible means of income or whose income falls below the official poverty threshold. Members of the households of the “Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program” (4Ps) shall be automatically considered as “poor” and are eligible to avail of the privileges under this Act.

Provides a fine of not less than Five Thousand Pesos (P5,000.00) but not more than Twenty Thousand Pesos (P20,000.00) for any public officer or employee who refuses or fails to provide the benefit granted to the poor job applicant.

States that a job applicant who misrepresents or falsifies any document to avail of benefits provided under this Act or abuses the privilege granted herein shall be prosecuted and punished in accordance with RA No. 3185, as amended, otherwise known as the Revised Penal Code, and shall suffer perpetual disqualification in availing the privileges under this Act.

rows.author: I010
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FRAMEWORK FOR CITIZENS PARTICIPATION IN LEGISLATIVE POLICYMAKING THROUGH THE USE OF INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY PLATFORMS
rows.title_short: Crowdsourcing In Legislative Policymaking Act.
rows.abstract:
Refers to “Crowdsourcing” as the practice of engaging individuals or a group towards a common goal, often at innovation, problem solving, or efficiency in the delivery of services. Powered by new technologies, social media and the development of the worldwide web 2.0, the individuals or groups are able to contribute to the formulation, improvement, and creation of laws that are beneficial to the nation.

Aims to enhance democracy in our country by engaging Filipinos to make legislative proposals that reflect their most pressing needs and concerns through the use of information and communication technology platforms. 

Crowdsourcing act may be done in the Senate and the House of Representatives a. On First Reading b. On Second Reading and c. On Third Reading; or through the Presidential Legislative Liaison (PLLO) Office which shall provide a platform through the internet where people can start a campaign or petition to review, amend and repeal a law or create a bill, the result of which may be transmitted to any member of both Houses for appropriate action.
